apps.localizedDescription: An on-device debugger and developer toolbox for iOS versions 17.4+ powered by idevice.  Note: Requires LocalDevVPN, cannot be natively used inside LiveContainer to enable JIT for the same LiveContainer.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: StikDebug needs access to devices on your local network so it can connect to the ip of the target device.
